resolverEnabled.description: Resolve identities across sources: key connector entities, gather the user's accounts, and adjudicate likely duplicates.

selfNames.description: Names the user goes by. The first becomes the label of the user's own Person entity.

selfEmails.description: Email addresses that belong to the user, besides the connected mail account.

selfHandles.description: The user's accounts as kind:value, e.g. github:octocat or linkedin:in/octocat. Connected Discord accounts are added automatically.

maxAdjudicationsPerRun.description: Maximum queued identity pairs the model decides per run (eight per request).

linkageMode.description: Record linkage before model adjudication: off; shadow (score queued pairs and record the score beside the model's verdict); active (settle confident pairs without the model).

linkageSameThreshold.description: Linkage probability at or above which a non-person pair is settled as the same identity (active mode).

linkagePersonSameThreshold.description: Linkage probability at or above which two people are settled as one; relational evidence (shared neighbours, email, or domain) is also required.

linkageDifferentThreshold.description: Linkage probability at or below which a pair is settled as different (active mode).

linkageRefitMinLabels.description: New model verdicts needed before the linkage model is refit (at most once a day).

maxNearDuplicatesPerRun.description: Maximum near-duplicate name pairs (MinHash over character 3-grams) queued per run.

llmModel.description: Optional chat model override for identity adjudication.

reasoningMode.description: Graph reasoner (hourly graph-reasoner cron): off; shadow (record would-be association edges, rule conclusions, conflicts, and pattern claims beside the model's claims, writing nothing); active (write them as proposed claims and contradiction links).

associationMinCooccurrence.description: Sources two entities must share before an ASSOCIATED_WITH edge is considered.

associationMinG2.description: Dunning log-likelihood (G²) an association edge needs; 10.83 is p < 0.001.

associationTopK.description: Association edges kept per entity (an edge survives in either endpoint's top K).

associationMaxDocFraction.description: Entities in more than this fraction of sources are ubiquitous and get no association edges.

ruleMaxDerivationsPerRun.description: Maximum rule conclusions (and contradiction links) per run.

ruleMinConfidence.description: Proposed claims scored below this are not premises for rules (unscored proposals are).

patternMinPrecision.description: Held-out precision a learned surface pattern needs to be kept.

patternMinSupport.description: Distinct seed pairs (model claims quoted with both names) a surface pattern needs.

patternSourcesPerRun.description: Recently digested sources the learned patterns are applied to per run.

searchIndexEnabled.description: Keep the fielded source search index (source_search_fts: title, entity names, keyphrases, summary, boilerplate-stripped body) up to date with the search-indexer cron and on source ingestion.

searchRanker.description: How search_graph ranks sources: 'bm25' (best chunk's BM25, the original path) or 'engine' (sdk/retrieval/engine.ts: query understanding, fielded BM25F plus entity, graph, recency, involvement and quality features, near-duplicate collapsing, MMR diversity). The engine falls back to bm25 until the search index is built.

searchWeights.description: Engine feature-weight overrides, e.g. {"recency": 0.3}. Features: bm25f, coverage, proximity, phrase, title, entity, graph, recency, upcoming, involvement, quality (penalty, ≤ 0), bulk (penalty, ≤ 0). Unset features use tuned weights (extension_state, from scripts/search-tune.ts) or the code defaults.
